title: Offline workouts, live friends and saved splits
summary: Log offline, see friends training live and keep your workout plans together.
changes: **Reliable saves:** Interrupted saves recover without duplicate workouts or runaway timers.
**Workout controls:** Pause live time, manage the slimmer rest timer and receive in-app rest alerts.
**Set colours:** Clearer RPE, warm-up, working, drop and failure sets, plus same-weight volume PR labels.
**Workout dates:** Overnight sessions keep their correct start date and duration.
**Exercise library:** Search by equipment, page results and add exercises without starting a workout.
**Muscle tracking:** Choose direct/partial credits by week and inspect each muscle's contributing workouts.
**Training trends:** Faster charts and useful eight-week trends for less-recent lifts.
**Body measurements:** Record circumferences and browse history by body part.
**FFMI:** Clearer calculations and sex-matched population references.
**Cardio goals:** Custom heart-rate zones, weekly targets and Home card designs.
**Cardio logging:** Edit suggested values immediately; screenshot scans discard images after reading them.
**Equipment:** Merge machines, swipe photos and save named settings with each workout.
**Imports:** Match exercise names and undo individual import batches.
**Find friends:** Add friends with QR codes and browse suggested public accounts.
**Reactions:** Use the Run reaction and see who reacted to a workout.
**Friend feed:** Load more friends inline and see local session timestamps.
**Live notifications:** Receive updates while browsing, with read states synced across devices.
**Profiles:** Faster loading and paged cardio history.
**Privacy:** Choose whether friends see your online status and live workouts.
**Account security:** Sign out across devices; revoked sessions lose access to live updates.
**Workout polish:** Clearer mixed-session labels, safer type validation and simpler notes/photo controls.
**Navigation:** Cleaner Home header, circular Start button and Settings opening at the overview.
**Security:** Safer push alerts, image processing, offline caches and CSV exports.
